meta.title: AI Translation (@scottzhb-hue/dsh-ai-translation)
meta.description: A complete CAT workbench inside DSH: source and target side by side, live TM and glossary hits, AI drafts, layout-preserving DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/EPUB/SDLXLIFF import and export. Beyond upstream CAIT: a project layer (one brief and one set of TM/glossaries shared by many files, project-level analysis, quotes, reports, delivery packages, time tracking, Unfiled and an all-documents view), pre-delivery checks and batch actions, match-band quotes and post-editing metrics, local MT, unlocked segment merge/split, select-to-create-term, draft recovery, an AI assistant that distils a conversation into the brief, wrapper-aware routing, token/cost tracking, legacy Office import with macros disabled, a home screen, a task-grouped top bar, cancellable batch import and a render error boundary. Thanks to Jovi Lecca, author of upstream CAIT (Apache-2.0).
